 Self-Aligning / Spherically Seated Compression Platens
Spherically seated compression platens are designed to accommodate compression specimens with surfaces that aren't completely parallel. During the application of a small pre-load, the platens self-align by up to 4° to match the specimen's top surface relative to the machine's loading axis. For some models, the spherical seat is integral to the compression platen; for others, the spherical seat can be added to convert a standard compression platen into a spherically seated platen.
Use the links below to jump directly to the section you're interested in:
Compression Platens with Integral Spherical Seat | High-Force Compression Platens | Spherical Seatings
 Compression Platens with Integral Spherical Seat
The hardened surface of these platens ensures no deformation of the platen occurs during testing while the polished finish minimizes friction between the platen and specimen. Platens that have a 100 mm or larger diameter include a locking mechanism to secure the spherical seat into position, ensuring it is parallel with the lower platen. An LVDT deflection sensor may be attached to provide high accuracy strain measurement.

 High-Force Compression Platens
The Industrial Series spherically seated compression platens offer an optimal balance of rigidity and self-alignment, ensuring uniform specimen loading. Compression platen combinations can be configured to comply with ASTM C39, C67, C109, C133, C140, C365, AASHTO T22, and other standards.
